study type: Secondary analysis of prospective, longitudinal cohort study
exposure: occupational lifting and/or pushing (Never, Infrequent, Frequent)
cohort: The study included 1590 parous women with current employment at the start of the SWAN study who were followed annually during mid-life.
finding: Infrequent and Frequent occupational lifting and/or pushing were significantly associated with an increased risk of developing new-onset symptomatic pelvic organ prolapse over 10 years in parous women.
